checks.describe: two names pointing at the same list see each other's in-place changes (id/is evidence, section 1)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.1 python3 -c "inventory = [{'name': 'web-01'}]; backup = inventory; backup.append({'name': 'web-02'}); print(len(inventory)); print(inventory is backup)"

checks.describe: a shallow copy still shares a nested mutable dict with the original (section 2)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.1 python3 -c "import copy; original = [{'tags': {'owner': 'a'}}]; shallow = copy.copy(original); shallow[0]['tags']['owner'] = 'b'; print(original[0]['tags']['owner'])"

checks.describe: a tuple allows mutating a mutable object in one of its slots, but raises TypeError when reassigning the slot itself (section 4)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.1 python3 -c "t = ('a', ['x']); t[1].append('y'); print(t); t[0] = 'z'" 2>&1
